note: Primitive camping beside the Champion Mill millpond on Frenchman Creek at the NW edge of Champion. Nebraska Game and Parks handed the mill and the 11-acre recreation area to Chase County on July 1, 2013; no county page found (2026-11-05), so site count, hookups, fee and season are unconfirmed. Directories list 6-8 flat dirt sites, some with electric. --Claude
summary: Not a state SRA since July 1, 2013: Chase County owns and runs it (ownership state -> local). No operator web page at all; only directories describe the camping. waterfront 'pond' is not a valid value and the millpond is ~4-5 acres -> not waterfront. Derived facilities/booking cleared. Drop candidate on the live-web-presence rule.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (presence): no operator page. Chase County took over Champion Mill SHP and the 11-acre SRA on July 1, 2013 (Wikipedia citing NGPC's 2013 release and the Wauneta Breeze, July 8, 2013). Chase County Tourism's recreation page (https://chasecounty.com/recreation/) lists Enders Reservoir and city parks but no Champion camping; chasecountyne.gov has no park page. The only descriptions are directories (The Dyrt: 8 primitive dirt sites, 2021 review; nebraskatravelerguide.com: 6 electric sites; campendium: no reservations). No dated rate anywhere. AWH's call: a real county campground with no web presence.

OWNERSHIP state -> local (Chase County, since 2013). It no longer inherits the state:NE policy row (RA booking, park entry permit). Name could become 'Champion Mill Recreation Area' / 'Champion Lake Recreation Area'; the 'State Recreation Area' title is out of date.

WATERFRONT 'pond' -> not waterfront: 'pond' is not a valid value. The millpond on imagery is ~120 x 150 m (~4-5 acres) below the dam at the NW corner of the village, so it is a pond under the ~5-acre line; the surface shows uniform green (weed/algae-covered or drawn down) with sand bars. Not waterfront either way.

WEBSITE https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/champion/ is NGPC's, which has not run the site since 2013 (blocked, unread); no county replacement exists. PHONE: none stored; directories give (308) 394-5118 (campground) and (308) 882-5860 (park), neither confirmed by an operator page.
PIN 40.47120,-101.75050 sits in the trees on the pond's east bank; directories place camping on the north side. Sites cannot be seen under canopy, so no move.
FIT for a 23-ft rig: unconfirmed (dirt sites, no pads; a 2021 Dyrt review says 'reasonably flat'). SAND: not applicable.
